Audience: first-time Arizona drivers and permit holders preparing for the written test in English, who may meet monsoon flash floods, northern Arizona snow and night freeway driving.
Why it matters to a first-timer: crossing a flooded wash or driving around a flood barricade carries real danger and cost [A01], the high and low beam rules use exact distances [A02], and wrong-way drivers on Arizona freeways call for a specific response [A03].
Level: practical recall of two headlight distances, step-by-step responses for hydroplaning, locked wheels and wrong-way drivers, and the flood liability rule.
Prerequisites: the braking, weather and dust storm pages that precede this section.
